name: @pryzm/street-analytics
description: PRYZM-STREET-MICROCLIMATE-PIPELINE (P1 L2 core) — pure, THREE/Cesium/DOM-free street-level microclimate math: a shared ground-plane StreetGrid + per-cell WIND comfort (Lawson LDC shelter heuristic), HEAT-island UHI delta, and POPULATION density (OSM floor-count proxy). Deterministic (no I/O, no RNG, no Date.now — the analysis date is an input). The Cesium/THREE renderers consume these colour-per-cell results.
